promises.label: FY27 revenue growth guidance constant currency
promises.quote: our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency terms
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY27 operating margin guidance
promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains the same at 20% to 22%
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: Mega deal to add over 1% growth FY28
promises.quote: This deal is expected to contribute over 1% growth for the company in FY28
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Hire approximately 20,000 freshers FY27
promises.quote: We hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 in line with our target of approximately 20,000 for FY27
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Return 85% of FCF over five years
promises.quote: 85% of the free cash flow that we generate, we will return back to shareholders over a five-year period
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Effective tax rate 29-30%
promises.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Acquisition to impact margins 50 bps
promises.quote: the acquisition that we have made will have 50 bps impact on our margins overall
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

reported.label: Q2 revenue $5,145 mn, +1.5% YoY cc
reported.quote: Q2 revenues were $5,145 mn, an increase of 1.2% sequentially and 1.5% on YoY in constant currency terms

reported.label: AI revenue 10.5% of total, +29% QoQ
reported.quote: Our AI revenue was standout at 10.5% of our total revenue, growing 29% sequentially. Last quarter, it was at 8.2%

reported.label: Large deal TCV $5.2 bn, 62% net new
reported.quote: We won 19 large deals in Q2 with a TCV of $5.2 bn... Of this, 62% was net new

reported.label: Free cash flow $928 mn, 113% of net profit
reported.quote: Free cash flow generation was strong at $928 mn at 113% of net profit

reported.label: Two mega deals: $2bn+ net new, $1bn renewal
reported.quote: One of these mega deals was for over $2 bn... The second mega deal was for $1 bn for a renewal

reported.label: Interim dividend ₹26, up 13% YoY
reported.quote: The Board has announced an interim dividend of `26, an increase of 13% compared to last year

reported.label: Attrition 12.7%; net headcount +4,400
reported.quote: Attrition reduced to 12.7% versus 13% sequentially... Net headcount increased by about 4,400 employees
